info.title: ECB Data Portal SDMX API
info.description: The anonymous, read-only SDMX 2.1 REST service for the European Central Bank Data Portal. The contract covers the three official resource families for statistical data, structural metadata, and structure-specific XML schemas, with separate path variants where the service permits omitted identifiers or versions. Data responses support SDMX-JSON, CSV, ECB pivot-table CSV, SDMX-ML 2.1 Generic Data, and Structure Specific Data.

get.description: Returns data from a dataflow. This variant omits the Series key and can therefore match many time series; callers should bound the response with date, detail, or observation-count parameters.

200.description: Successful request; the representation is selected by the format query parameter or Accept header.

304.description: No change since the If-Modified-Since value; the response has no body.

400.description: The query parameters contain a syntax or semantic error.

406.description: The requested representation is not supported.

500.description: An internal ECB service error occurred.

501.description: The request uses SDMX REST functionality not implemented by the ECB service.

503.description: The ECB service is temporarily unavailable.

get.x-pontx-proxy-disabled-reason: Hub proxying is disabled during candidate pre-admission; SDK and CLI validation is limited to caller-direct anonymous read-only requests.

flowRef.name: flowRef
flowRef.description: Dataflow reference: a flow ID, or comma-separated agency ID, flow ID, and version.

key.name: key
key.description: Series key in DSD dimension order; dot-separated, with empty wildcard segments and `+` for OR.

startPeriod.name: startPeriod
startPeriod.description: An ISO 8601 or SDMX reporting period: annual, semi-annual, quarterly, monthly, weekly, or daily.

endPeriod.name: endPeriod
endPeriod.description: An ISO 8601 or SDMX reporting period: annual, semi-annual, quarterly, monthly, weekly, or daily.

updatedAfter.name: updatedAfter
updatedAfter.description: Return the latest values added, revised, or deleted after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

firstNObservations.name: firstNObservations
firstNObservations.description: Maximum observations returned per matching time series, starting at the first observation.

lastNObservations.name: lastNObservations
lastNObservations.description: Maximum observations returned per matching time series, counting backward from the latest observation.

includeHistory.name: includeHistory
includeHistory.description: Whether to include historical versions of matching data.

format.name: format
format.description: Response format; it can also be selected through the Accept header.

ifModifiedSince.name: If-Modified-Since
ifModifiedSince.description: HTTP conditional-request timestamp. The service returns 304 when data has not changed.

dataAccept.name: Accept
dataAccept.description: Selects the response representation. The ECB recommends versioned, specific media types.

metadataAccept.name: Accept
metadataAccept.description: Selects the response representation. The ECB recommends versioned, specific media types.

acceptEncoding.name: Accept-Encoding
acceptEncoding.description: Requests a compressed response, for example gzip.

agencyID.name: agencyID
agencyID.description: Identifier of the SDMX agency maintaining the artefact.

references.name: references
references.description: Includes or excludes related artefacts; a concrete resource type is also accepted.

context.name: context
context.description: SDMX constraint context used to generate the XML Schema.

SdmxDataMessage.title: SDMX data message
SdmxDataMessage.description: An SDMX-JSON 1.0.0-wd data message. The schema models the top-level, structure, dimension, attribute, series, and observation relationships declared by ECB content negotiation and verified in a bounded live response; dynamic Series keys and observation indexes are represented as maps.

SdmxLink.title: SDMX resource link
SdmxLink.description: Link to a related SDMX resource.

SdmxStructure.title: SDMX data structure
SdmxStructure.description: SDMX data structure describing dimensions, attributes, and their value dictionaries.

SdmxComponent.title: SDMX dimension or attribute
SdmxComponent.description: An SDMX dimension or attribute definition.

SdmxComponentValue.title: SDMX component value
SdmxComponentValue.description: A value-dictionary entry for an SDMX dimension or attribute.

SdmxDataSet.title: SDMX dataset
SdmxDataSet.description: An SDMX dataset whose Series keys are dynamic map keys.

SdmxSeries.title: SDMX time series
SdmxSeries.description: One matching time series and its observations.

SdmxObservationTuple.title: SDMX observation tuple
SdmxObservationTuple.description: Tuple containing an observation value and attribute indexes.

ErrorBody.title: ECB error response
ErrorBody.description: ECB does not declare a stable error-body schema; the SDK preserves an error body as a string.
